column1: # Rows db.ptr.ps.* (line RG, D3c-3b): psiblast -in_pssm of NCBI's pointer forms where its reader reads an empty CRef<> (an OPTIONAL member held by CRef<>, an element of a list of CRef<>s, every such member in a skip: NULL, @n, :Type value) against tests/db_search/paja (-comp_based_stats 0 -evalue 1000, outfmt 7; the query_* rows also outfmt 0 and 11): tests/fixtures/pssm/d3b_<case>.asn.gz, hand edits of the rnd PSSM without intermediateData, and d3b_b_<case>.asnb, hand edits of ps9_ber_base.asnb (probe D3c-3b). The losat-rejection rows are LOSAT's refusals of a value of another type than the declared one (what NCBI does with it depends on the types its process has met) and of an element stated as NULL outside a skip (NCBI's program dereferences it: a report of its memory addresses, or psiblast's engine error deep in its set-up). Freeze them alone with `freeze --program psiblast --only db.ptr.ps.`.
